lab_experiments.title: Two LEDs Blinking
lab_experiments.task: Blink two LEDs continuously at 1s interval using digital output pins (Pins 12, 13).
viva_questions: What is the role of transmit buffers, receive FIFOs, and acceptance filters in the STM32H7 FDCAN peripheral?
Name two common CAN bit rates (e.g., 250 kbps, 500 kbps, 1 Mbps).

lab_experiments.title: LED Control via Push Button
lab_experiments.task: Control LED with momentary push button (Pins 2, 12 with INPUT_PULLUP).
viva_questions: What is the role of a CAN transceiver between the MCU and the bus (converts TTL logic to differential voltage)?
What is the purpose of the CRC field in CAN (cyclic redundancy check for transmission error detection)?

lab_experiments.title: LED Brightness via Potentiometer (PWM)
lab_experiments.task: Read analog value from potentiometer on A0 and map to PWM output on Pin 9 (0-255).
viva_questions: Why are 120-ohm termination resistors used in a CAN bus (impedance matching to prevent signal reflections)?
What is the Nyquist criterion (sampling rate must be at least twice the maximum signal frequency)?

lab_experiments.title: Light Intensity Measurement using LDR
lab_experiments.task: Measure surrounding light using LDR voltage divider on A0 and print lux condition to Serial Monitor.
viva_questions: What is the purpose of the ACK field in CAN?
What is an error frame, and why does CAN automatically retransmit a failed message?

lab_experiments.title: Distance Measurement using Ultrasonic Sensor
lab_experiments.task: HC-SR04 pulse duration measurement and convert to cm on Serial Monitor.
viva_questions: What do the proportional, integral, and derivative terms contribute to a PID controller?
How many data bytes can a Classical CAN frame carry (up to 8 bytes, compared to 64 in CAN FD)?

lab_experiments.title: Human Movement Detection using PIR Sensor
lab_experiments.task: Digital read PIR sensor and output Motion Detected / No Motion.
viva_questions: What are command, telemetry, and heartbeat messages in a CAN application?
What is the difference between a data frame and a remote frame?

lab_experiments.title: Servo Motor Angular Sweep
lab_experiments.task: Sweep servo from 0 to 180 degrees and return with step delays.
viva_questions: What is bumpless transfer (smooth switching between manual and automatic control)?
What does DLC indicate in a CAN frame (Data Length Code, number of payload bytes)?

lab_experiments.title: 16x2 I2C LCD Interfacing
lab_experiments.task: Display Name on Row 1 and Roll Number on Row 2 via I2C address (0x27 or 0x3F).
viva_questions: Why is discrete-time PID used in a microcontroller, and what is the sampling period?
If two nodes transmit simultaneously, which CAN identifier wins arbitration (the lower numerical ID / dominant bits)?

lab_experiments.title: Temperature Measurement using Thermistor
lab_experiments.task: 10k NTC thermistor (Beta=3950) on Pin A1 with 10k resistor divider to measure temperature in Celsius.
viva_questions: What is CAN, and where is it commonly used (automotive, avionics, industrial automation)?
How can CAN identifiers be assigned to give important messages higher priority?
